sentences.translation: Today I will learn about the compound particles and sentence ending expressions at the N1 level.
## Composite
A compound particle is a particle made of two or more elements combined.
It is often used in formal writings and speeches.
despite ### ~
It means "even though it is ~" or "but it is ~" inversely.
It is written and expressive, giving a more formal impression than the "no" of spoken words.
Example:
Despite the bad weather, the game was held as planned.'
Despite the effort, the results were not good.'
Despite the opposition, the plan was approved.'
On ###
It means "as a central issue" and "as a matter of conflict or discussion".
Use it when something is at the center of a discussion or a conflict.
Example:
He fought with his neighbor over the ownership of the land.'
There are various opinions about the new law.'
There was a heated discussion on how to use the budget.
The Preface to ###
It represents special scenes and opportunities in the sense of "time" and "time".
It is often used in a modified scene.
Example:
Please submit the necessary documents when entering the school.'
"Please read the contents carefully when you sign the contract."
"The company paid the allowance when you were transferred overseas."
## End-of-Sentence Expression
### ~ must be
It represents a strong belief that there is a basis.
It is a written expression of "I bet ~".
Example:
"He must have known already,"
"There must be an economic factor behind this problem."
No more than ###
It is an emphasis expression that says "It is exactly ~" and "It is nothing but ~".
Example:
This is the result of my efforts.'
"They are discriminatory."
The secret of success is to continue.'
### must be
It means "I have to." It represents a unavoidable situation.
Negative form "~zu" + "not to get" form.
Please note that "do" is "too much."
Example:
"I have to admit that I have evidence."
The budget was cut and the plan was forced to be reduced.'
"I have to refuse, given the circumstances."
## Let's check in the newspaper.
"The government has given up on reducing social security costs despite financial difficulties.
There is a heated debate between the ruling and opposition parties over the decision.
Experts point out that we will have to put off fiscal reforms at this rate.
Some say that this decision is only a conscious decision of the election."
## Roundup
| Expression | Semantic | Use Scenes |
| Despite ~ | | | | Inverse and Written
On | | | | On | | (discussion / conflict) | At the center of the problem |
| When in ~(revised) | Special occasions and procedures | |
| must be _ _ must be _ _ strong conviction |
| It is nothing but | It is exactly | Emphasis |
| must _ must | must _ must _
